environment.isolation: Shared desktop host. A macOS media-analysis daemon and an idle Docker virtual machine were running; see capture_load. No exclusive-host or thermal-control claim.

profile.diagnostics: non-clearing native loss/retransmission before and after timing; OS resource deltas
profile.payload: all received bytes verified; Live sequence and boundaries checked
profile.offered_load: unpaced, native nonblocking backpressure; no application rate cap

controls.statistic: paired geometric mean ratios; 10000 paired bootstrap draws, percentile 95% CI; no exclusions
controls.scope: Provisional measured profile only, not deployment qualification; CPU seconds are not hardware cycles

capture_load.note: One-minute system load average sampled every 10 s during this case; added after capture. Includes the benchmark itself.
